entries.owner: modules/managementmcp, application/service/mcp_oauth*, infrastructure/repository/mcp_oauth*, transport/http/managementmcp and features/mcp
entries.decision: The previous defer was superseded by a compatible implementation. Migration 252 preserves existing migration 249, MCP uses a path-specific OAuth issuer, current management ownership/permissions/audit/step-up are retained, and the security diff scan found zero reportable findings.
entries.reopen_when: MCP tool catalog, OAuth authority, redaction keys, resource limits, migration trigger coverage or reverse-proxy Origin/Host assumptions change.

entries.subject: fix(frontend): upgrade vue-i18n to v11 and patch decode-uri-component
entries.decision: The local baseline already carries vue-i18n 11.4.16 and Node 24. Add the missing decode-uri-component lower-bound override, remove the obsolete JIT macro, and assert rendered messages under v11.
